hypothesis: Meaningful Form 4 open-market purchase event-days may improve current accepted A/B trade confirmation or ranking if they appear shortly before accepted entries.
decision_rationale: Prior meaningful Form 4 events are too sparse near accepted A/B entries: no accepted trades have a 5/10/20-day prior match, and only two trades match within 60 calendar days. Form 4 still has positive standalone shadow outcomes, but current evidence does not justify promoting it as an accepted-trade ranking or confirmation overlay.
next_action: If continuing Form 4 work, evaluate it as a scarce external event source against skipped candidates or event-driven watchlist days, not as a near-entry overlay on the current accepted A/B trade set.
